name: Sceptre of Light
summary: At Thunder Axe Fortress, the Burning Blade has the Sceptre of Light, said to have come from the naga. Azore Aldamort fears it can sink whole cities beneath the great seas, so he asks you to bring it to Ethel Rethor.

sections.title: A Sceptre of the Naga
sections.body: Word has spread that the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress holds the naga's Sceptre of Light. Legend says the sceptre can sink whole cities beneath the great seas. Azore Aldamort will not let the Burning Blade keep such power.

sections.title: The Seer's Tower
sections.body: A Burning Blade seer keeps the sceptre in a watchtower atop the fortress and studies it there. Azore asks you to take the sceptre from the seer and carry it back to the tower at Ethel Rethor.

faq.q: What power does the Sceptre of Light possess?
aliases: what does sceptre of light do
how powerful is sceptre of light
faq.answer: Legend says the Sceptre of Light can sink whole cities beneath the great seas. Word is that the Burning Blade obtained it from the naga.

faq.q: Who currently holds the Sceptre of Light?
aliases: who has the sceptre of light
faq.answer: A Burning Blade seer keeps the Sceptre of Light in a watchtower at Thunder Axe Fortress and studies it there.

faq.q: Who asks for the Sceptre of Light?
aliases: where to pick up sceptre of light
faq.answer: Azore Aldamort, who is at the tower at Ethel Rethor, asks for the Sceptre of Light.

faq.q: How did the Burning Blade get the sceptre?
aliases: how did burning blade get the sceptre
faq.answer: Word is that the Burning Blade obtained the sceptre from the naga.
